title: Cheapest iPhone 17 in Singapore (2026) — Live Prices Compared
description: Where the iPhone 17 is cheapest in Singapore right now: live prices from Apple Singapore, Challenger, Courts, Shopee Mall, LazMall and telco bundles, compared daily, with buying advice on warranty, telco lock-in and what changed from the iPhone 16.
heroTitle: Cheapest iPhone 17 in Singapore — 2026 live price comparison
heroTitleTemplate: Cheapest iPhone 17 in Singapore (2026) — from {floorPrice} today
heroBody: Apple launched the iPhone 17 in late 2025 with a ProMotion display across the whole line and a 48MP ultrawide, and Singapore pricing has settled into a familiar pattern: the Apple Singapore Store and authorised resellers hold the list price, while Shopee Mall, LazMall official stores and parallel importers undercut it during platform sales. This page pulls the live Singapore listings from BuyWhere's catalog every few minutes so you can see the current floor, who is offering it, and whether the cheapest listing is a local set with Apple Singapore warranty or a parallel import.

highlights.title: ProMotion for everyone
highlights.body: For the first time Apple put the 120Hz ProMotion display across the entire iPhone 17 line, not just the Pro. If you have been holding an older non-Pro iPhone for the smoother scrolling and better gaming response, the iPhone 17 is the obvious upgrade.

highlights.title: 48MP ultrawide and selfie camera
highlights.body: The ultrawide sensor doubled to 48MP and the front camera is now also 24MP, which makes a real difference for group selfies, vlogging and ultrawide landscape shots on travel. The Pro models keep the dedicated 5x telephoto lens that the base iPhone 17 still lacks.

highlights.title: Battery and charging
highlights.body: Apple's own battery life claim steps up versus the iPhone 16, with USB-C charging on every model. Wireless MagSafe and Qi2 speeds are unchanged, and the new camera-control button on the side is a quiet quality-of-life win for one-handed shooting.

adviceSectionTitle: How to pay the least without getting burned
advicePoints: Check whether the listing says 'local set' or 'Apple Singapore warranty'. Parallel imports are cheaper but Apple Singapore stores will not service them under warranty, and you cannot register them for AppleCare+ in Singapore.

Time it: Shopee and Lazada official stores discount deepest on 9.9, 10.10, 11.11, 12.12 and mid-month payday campaigns; Challenger and Courts tend to mirror within a week with their own voucher promos.

Stack vouchers before you compare: a higher sticker price with a platform coupon, free-shipping voucher and coin cashback often beats the lowest raw listing — and you can usually combine with card instalment 0%.

If you were going to sign a Singtel / StarHub / M1 plan anyway, run the numbers on the contract bundle. Heavy data users can come out meaningfully ahead even though the headline phone price is higher.
If you already own the iPhone 16 and mostly use the main camera and battery, the upgrade is hard to justify — put the money toward the iPhone 16 replacement battery or a MagSafe charger instead.

faqs.question: Is the iPhone 17 worth it over the iPhone 16 in Singapore?
faqs.answer: If you want ProMotion (120Hz) on a base iPhone, a meaningfully better ultrawide and selfie camera, or longer battery life, yes. If your iPhone 16 still feels fast and you are happy with the camera, the upgrade is hard to justify this year.

faqs.question: Do parallel-import iPhones come with Apple warranty in Singapore?
faqs.answer: No. Apple Singapore honours warranty for local sets only. Parallel-import listings carry the shop's own warranty, which is why they are cheaper, and AppleCare+ cannot be purchased for them in Singapore.

faqs.question: When is the iPhone 17 cheapest in Singapore?
faqs.answer: Historically during platform sale days (9.9, 11.11, 12.12) and payday campaigns on Shopee and Lazada, with Challenger and Courts matching within days. Outside those windows the live prices on this page show the current floor.

faqs.question: Should I buy the iPhone 17 or iPhone 17 Pro in Singapore?
faqs.answer: The Pro adds a 5x telephoto lens, a titanium body, a brighter display and longer battery life. If you shoot a lot of zoom or want the best thermals for gaming, the Pro earns the price gap. For everyone else the base iPhone 17 is the smarter buy.

faqs.question: Can I use a parallel-import iPhone 17 with Singtel or StarHub in Singapore?
faqs.answer: Yes for network — Singapore carriers are SIM-free and unlocked by default. The catch is warranty: parallel imports are not serviceable by Apple Singapore and you cannot add AppleCare+ locally.

categoryIntro.heading: Why Singapore iPhone prices vary so much
categoryIntro.body: Singapore has no single dominant electronics retailer, so the same Apple product is sold by the Apple Store, authorised resellers like Challenger and Courts, three telco contract bundles, marketplace official stores and dozens of parallel importers at once. Prices move with platform campaigns rather than with Apple, which is why a static 'best price' article goes stale within days and why this page reads live listings instead.
